title: Motifs, tapestry, amigurumi da Tunisiya: crochet da ke siyarwa

say: Motifs, tapestry, amigurumi da Tunisiya: crochet da ke siyarwa.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo na module uku na Advanced Knitting da Crochet.

Crochet yana da sauri kuma yana da ƙarfi. Wannan tsarin ya ƙunshi iyalai huɗu waɗanda ke siyar da kyau. Motifs da aka haɗa suna yin barguna da jakunkuna. Tapestry crochet yana yin jakunkuna masu ƙarfi.

say: Amigurumi yana yin kayan wasan yara cushe, kuma ƙwanƙwasa na Tunisiya yana yin gyale da tulun auduga tare da saƙa. Duk umarni anan suna amfani da sharuɗɗan Amurka.

say: Ƙwarewar ba ta yin murabba'i ɗaya ba. Yana yin murabba'ai da yawa girmansu iri ɗaya. A cikin babban filin granny, zagaye n yana da sau 4 n gungu. Idan lissafin ku ya bambanta, murabba'in zai karkata.
Misali, Bisi a Akure yana yin murabba'i guda 4, ya toshe shi, kuma yana auna cm 10 kuma yana auna 9g.

say: Abokin ciniki yana son kusan 80 ta 100 cm. Wato murabba'i 8 a fadin da 10 ƙasa: murabba'i 80, da 720 g na yarn.

say: Ta ƙara kusan kashi 15 na shiga da iyaka, 828 g. A cikin 50 g bukukuwa wato 16.6, don haka ta sayi 17, duk daga rini daya. Yanzu za ta iya faɗi farashin yarn na gaske.

say: Haɗin ɗinki mai zamewa yana ba da ƙoƙon ado. Haɗin crochet guda ɗaya ya fi ƙarfi, yana da kyau ga jakunkuna masu ɗaukar nauyi.

panel.heading: Zaɓi haɗin don aikin
items: Slip stitch: kayan ado mai tasowa
Keɓaɓɓen ɗaki ɗaya: m, don jakunkuna
Ƙwallon bulala: lebur, don kayan jarirai

say: Ƙwaƙwalwar bulala tare da allurar kaset yana da lebur, yana da kyau ga tufafi da kayan jarirai. Join-as-you-go yana haɗa kowane filin wasa a zagaye na ƙarshe, wanda ke adana lokaci akan manyan barguna.
Toshe kowane murabba'i zuwa girman guda kafin haɗawa, kuma fara ɗaukar shimfidar wuri.

say: A cikin zanen kaset, launin da ba ka amfani da shi yana kwance a saman saman dinkin, kuma ka zana shi, don haka yana ɓoye.

panel.heading: Canja launi kuma dace da ginshiƙi
items: Dauke launi B a cikin dinkin

say: Don canza launi, a kan ɗinkin ƙarshe mai launi A ɗaga madauki, don haka kuna da madaukai 2 akan ƙugiya. Sa'an nan kuma zare da launi B kuma ja ta cikin biyun.

say: Misali, Zainab a Kano tana da lu'u lu'u lu'u-lu'u mai fadi 12. Gilashin gindinta yana ƙara ɗimbin 6 kowane zagaye, don haka zagaye na 10 yana da 60. 60 da aka raba ta 12 shine lu'u-lu'u 5. Ya yi daidai, don haka babu motif da ke karya inda aka fara zagaye.

panel.rule: Dole ne ƙidaya ɗin ɗinkin zagaye ya zama maɗaukakin faɗin motif.

say: Amigurumi ƙananan kayan wasa ne masu cike da kaya, ana aiki da su a cikin ƙuƙumi guda ɗaya tare da alama a farkon kowane zagaye.
Fara da dinki 6 a cikin zoben sihiri, kuma ƙara dinki 6 kowane zagaye: 12, 18, 24, 30.

panel.heading: Girman haɓaka shida
items: Rage 6 kowane zagaye, a cikin tsari na madubi
Kaya da ƙarfi, sannan rufe 6 na ƙarshe

say: Yi aiki a fili, sannan rage 6 kowane zagaye a cikin tsari na madubi. Kaya da ƙarfi kafin zagaye na ƙarshe, kuma rufe shi kamar zaren zare.
Juya ƙarar kowane zagaye, ko ƙwallon ya juya zuwa hexagon.

say: Amintaccen kayan wasan yara ya zo farko. Don jarirai da yara a ƙasa da 3, saka idanu da hanci tare da zaren. Ƙananan sassan da ke fitowa suna da haɗari.

panel.heading: Sanya kowane abin wasan yara lafiya

cards.d: Emroider idanu da hanci tare da zaren. Babu idanun filastik, maɓalli ko beads waɗanda za su iya fitowa.
Yi amfani da sabo, tsabtace kayan wasan yara. Dinka gabobi a jiki sau da yawa.

cards.t: Ja gwada kowane abin wasan yara
cards.d: Ja kowane bangare da ƙarfi kafin ka sayar ko kyauta. Babu dogayen igiyoyi ko madaukai.

say: Yi amfani da sabo, tsaftataccen kayan wasan yara na polyester, ba tsohowar matashin cikawa ko tsumma ba. Dinka gabobi da kunnuwa a jiki sau da yawa.

say: Kwangilar Tunisiya na amfani da dogon ƙugiya kuma yana riƙe madaukai da yawa akansa, kamar allura mai sakawa. A kan wucewar gaba za ku ɗauki madaukai. Lokacin wucewar dawowa kuna kashe su, biyu a lokaci guda. Ba za ku taɓa juya aikin ba.
